Card Q&A.a: When performing a non-DNA digivolution, only the “Place 1 yellow or purple Digimon card from your trash on top of your security stack face down” part of the effect activates. Card Q&A.a: Level 4 or lower. If the same reference to a "played" trigger condition being performed is made for an effect when it has a "when X is played" trigger condition, the state when the effect has triggered will be referenced. In this case, your Digimon was level 4 when this card's [All Turns] effect triggered, therefore you can delete a level 4 or lower Digimon.
